criteria.plain_summary: An anti-inflammatory pain medicine and a blood thinner supplied together can raise the risk of serious bleeding.
criteria.rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when at least one Group A medicine AND at least one Group B medicine both appear in the history with supply dates that overlap or fall within 60 days of each other.
criteria.cannot_be_seen: Why the anticoagulant was started, kidney function, any history of bleeding, and any pain or stomach medicines bought without a prescription.
criteria.ask_the_gp: Whether the NSAID is still needed while the anticoagulant continues, and the patient's risk of bleeding.
